title: Past Conferences
body:
Past Duke GMH Conferences

This year marks the 3rd annual Duke Global Mental Health Conferences, with past conferences in the 2024–2025 and 2025–2026 academic years. You can learn more about our last conference, hosted in October 2025, on the 2025 conference website.
